name: Colombia
summary: Equatorial South American nation spanning Pacific, Andean, Caribbean, Orinoco, and Amazonian biomes. Exceptional Andean water endowments support a hydro-dominated national grid.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 3.36x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Andean valley basins (Bogota, Medellin Aburra Valley) experience localized vehicle trapping.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; El Nino episodes cause acute Andean reservoir depletion and heat stress.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Equatorial warming rate across Andean and Amazonian monitoring stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.3% share of global fossil emissions; major thermal coal exporter with low domestic fossil generation.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Low per capita footprint; over 70% of electricity is generated from zero-carbon hydropower.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~593,000 km² of Amazonian and Choco rainforests; deforestation monitoring active in Guaviare.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Andean runoff provides 71.2% of national power via hydroelectric dams, supplemented by expanding solar.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 47 people/km²; urban population fraction is 82.2%.
